description: Renovate preset for the sharkops-io org, applied to every repo through org-inherited-config.json.
minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour 'timestamp-optional' only governs dependencies whose datasource returns no releaseTimestamp (common for OCI charts); it does not make the 1-day wait advisory.

packageRules.description: Nothing in sharkops-io is published until a tag, so minor/patch bumps automerge once checks pass. NOT sharkops-io/.github: its reusable workflows run in every repo.
